capabilities.untrusted: Device deployment and external tools are disabled in untrusted workspaces.
config.tools.hdcPath: Path to the hdc executable. Empty = auto-detect (overrides version-aware selection).
config.tools.hdcServer: Host hdc server endpoint for `hdc -s` (e.g. `127.0.0.1:8711` when qemu-ide uses a non-default port). Empty uses the hdc default unless `OHOS_HDC_SERVER_PORT` is set.
config.device.targetKey: Hdc target key (from Refresh Devices). Empty = auto-select when exactly one device is connected.
config.build.backend: Build backend: fixture zip (CI), ace-loader when toolchain/env/path is set, or auto.
config.build.aceLoaderPath: Path to upstream ace-loader root (directory containing webpack.lite.config.js).
config.tools.hdcOhVersion: Force which OpenHarmony host hdc toolchain to use when auto-detection from the device fails. Empty = detect from device / project SDK.
config.tools.hdcOhVersion.auto: Auto-detect from the connected device (or project SDK before connect).
config.tools.hdcOhVersion.503: OpenHarmony 5.0.x host hdc (bundled path …/v5.0.3/ or SDK).
config.tools.hdcOhVersion.61: OpenHarmony 6.1.x host hdc (bundled path …/v6.1-lts/ or SDK).
config.device.profile: Device profile id or path to a device profile JSON file.
config.advanced.outputEncoding: Encoding used to decode output of external tools (auto tries UTF-8 then GBK).
config.device.profileOverrides: Overrides for paths, ports and command templates of the active device profile.
config.device.display: Override the display resolution of the active device profile.
debuggers.ohjs.label: OpenHarmony Lite JS
debuggers.ohjs.bundle: Application bundle name (from config.json when empty).
debuggers.ohjs.ability: Main ability name (from config.json when empty).
debuggers.ohjs.localPort: Host TCP port for hdc fport to device Jerry port 5001.
debuggers.ohjs.preDeploy: Build and deploy the HAP before starting the debug session.
debuggers.ohjs.snippetDesc: Deploy (optional) and attach JerryScript debugger via hdc.
config.sdkVersion: OpenHarmony SDK version whose component schema drives HML completion and diagnostics.
config.diagnostics.transpilableSyntax: Severity of ES2015+ syntax in page `.js` files that ace-loader's babel transpiles to ES5 (`js/es6-syntax`). Untranspilable syntax (async/await, generators, BigInt) and missing built-in APIs are always errors; tune them per rule in `#ohjs.lang.rules#`, which also overrides this setting.
